title: DRAM Bender: An Extensible and Versatile FPGA-based Infrastructure to Easily Test State-of-the-art DRAM Chips
supports: Open-source FPGA DRAM tester: issue any DRAM command at any timing; C++ and Python APIs; ported to five FPGA boards with DDR3/DDR4 (via search snippet). No DDR5 support found in results.

title: DRAM Bender (ETH Research Collection record)
supports: DRAM Bender published in IEEE TCAD; code on GitHub CMU-SAFARI/DRAM-Bender; five FPGA boards, DDR3/DDR4 (via search snippet)

title: FMS 2024 TEST-301-1 (Luo, SAFARI) DRAM Bender slides
supports: Lists Xilinx and BittWare boards for DDR4 DIMM/SODIMM plus an HBM2 board; optional DRAM temperature control and DDR4 VPP control (via search snippet)

title: EasyDRAM (SAFARI) FPGA framework for end-to-end evaluation of DRAM techniques on real chips
supports: EasyDRAM: FPGA framework that runs real workloads against real DRAM chips with modified controller behaviour (via search snippet)

title: The Reach Profiler (REAPER): Enabling the Mitigation of DRAM Retention Failures via Profiling at Aggressive Conditions (ISCA 2017)
supports: Profiling ~250 ms above the target refresh interval reaches >99% coverage of failing cells with <50% false positives; VRT and data-pattern dependence make retention profiling hard (via search snippet). No BER-vs-interval numbers in snippet.

title: REAPER full talk (ISCA 2017)
supports: Characterization used 368 LPDDR4 chips from three vendors; cells change retention time dynamically (VRT) (via search snippet)

title: Enabling Effective Error Mitigation in Memory Chips That Use On-Die Error-Correcting Codes (Patel thesis)
supports: REAPER runs as memory-controller firmware: takes exclusive DRAM access, stretches refresh interval or temperature, records failing addresses; thesis covers on-die ECC obscuring raw errors (via search snippet)

title: Retrospective: RAIDR: Retention-Aware Intelligent DRAM Refresh
supports: Retrospective frames REAPER as the practical way to exploit heterogeneous retention under VRT, building on RAIDR (via search snippet)

title: Understanding RowHammer Under Reduced Refresh Latency: Experimental Analysis of Real DRAM Chips and Implications on Future Solutions (PaCRAM, HPCA 2025)
supports: 388 real DDR4 chips from three makers; preventive refresh latency can be cut ~64% with partial charge restoration if the RowHammer mitigation is made more aggressive; code at github.com/CMU-SAFARI/PaCRAM (via search snippet)

title: Reducing DRAM Latency via Charge-Level-Aware Look-Ahead Partial Restoration (MICRO 2018 poster)
supports: Partial restoration to cut latency; restoration is up to 43.6% of total DRAM access latency (via search snippet)

title: DejaVu: Why You Should Write to Your DRAM Rows Twice, Carefully (ISCA 2026)
supports: Overwriting a victim row with opposite data lowers ACmin: prior data affects read-disturb vulnerability, possibly via under-restoration of charge (via search snippet)

title: Agilex 7 FPGA I-Series Development Kit 2x R-Tile 1x F-Tile (Rev B)
supports: Current Rev B kit (DK-DEV-AGI027-RA-B); two PCIe/CXL 5.0 x16 interfaces over R-Tile (via search snippet)

title: KIT Operating Systems Group CXL hardware page
supports: Agilex 7 I-Series dev kit ~EUR 9k via Mouser; Altera CXL Type 3 IP license (IP-CXLTYP3) ~EUR 192k via DigiKey (via search snippet; price date Jan 2025)

title: Agilex 7 FPGA I-Series Development Kit User Guide
supports: A separate CXL IP license is required for CXL use with Quartus Prime (via search snippet)

title: US 7,447,974 Memory controller method and system compensating for memory cell data losses
supports: Controller ECC lets the refresh timer run at a slower rate because resulting bit errors can be corrected; family incl. US 7,428,687, 7,447,973, 9,064,600, 8,689,077 (via search snippet). Old family -> core 'ECC lets refresh slow down' idea is public domain/expired prior art.

title: US 9,064,600 Memory controller method and system compensating for memory cell data losses
supports: Continuation of the ECC-relaxed-refresh family; notes ECC capacity cost and power of checking read data during refresh (via search snippet)

title: US 12,488,827 CXL device and operation method of CXL device
supports: CXL device whose refresh controller counts commands per memory and issues targeted refresh to mitigate row hammer; no relaxed-refresh/ECC claim seen (via search snippet)

title: US7493531B2 Semiconductor memory device and refresh period controlling method (Elpida)
supports: Adjusts refresh period by monitoring error count/rate on expected-value data in self-refresh mode (via search snippet)

title: US 11,907,545 On-the-fly multiplexing scheme for compressed soft bit data in non-volatile memories
supports: NAND soft-bit sensing: second pass with longer discharge time on pre-charged sense node; soft data compressed on die before sending to ECC (via search snippet). Analogue of DRAM SA delayed-sample flag in NAND.

title: US 11,971,829 On-the-fly compression scheme for soft bit data in non-volatile memory
supports: Compressing soft-bit data on the memory die to reduce bus traffic to the controller (via search snippet)

title: US 6,065,146 Error correcting memory
supports: DRAM with on-chip Hamming ECC correcting during refresh (via search snippet)

title: EP 0442301 A2 DRAM with on-chip ECC and redundancy (IBM)
